name: 01-movement-pickup-deposit
note: walks +Z at exactly player_speed, picks 3 motes at pickup_radius, deposits them and lights L1

name: 02-win-all-lit
note: lighting the fifth lantern ends the night with won/all_lit and stops early

name: 03-pulse-stuns-shade
note: pulse stuns S1, pushes it pulse_push_m away, then the stun expires and it chases again

name: 04-ink-hit-drops-light
note: a touch costs one flame and drops hit_drop_ratio of the bag; invuln_s spaces the next hit 90 ticks later

name: 05-dawn-lost
note: running out of night time ends the run with lost/dawn at exactly time_left_s

name: 06-safe-haven
note: a lit lantern keeps Bóng Mực outside safe_radius, so the player cannot be touched

name: 07-default-island
note: the shipped Night 1 with random motes and random shade spawns (tick 360 and 960)

name: 08-invalid-scenario
note: a malformed scenario file must exit 2 with a message on stderr
